summary: Frontend-only regression after Expo SDK 54→57 upgrade. BUG 2 (Checklist sub-items) CONFIRMED and reproduced deterministically: sub-items added via 'Add sub-item' + Enter (confirmNewSubItem) are visible in UI (state updates, 'Unsaved changes' banner appears) but the auto-save on navigate-back (useFocusEffect cleanup at /app/frontend/app/checklists/[id].tsx:162-171) DOES NOT persist them to AsyncStorage. Verified via SPA back navigation (router.back equivalent, page.go_back) and via full nav — both leave subItems: [] in aufmassprofi_checklists storage. Only the explicit 'Save & Back' button (handleSave) reliably persists sub-items. On reopen the sub-item is gone. BUG 1 (Sketch tools): /sketches/draw screen loads cleanly with no console errors, all toolbars render, Elemente:0 counter visible; default tool is 'Zoom' (highlighted green) — not Pen. Comprehensive canvas interaction testing (pen drag, edit/select/move, delete, undo) via Playwright mouse events is unreliable against React Native PanResponder on web preview and was NOT completed in this run. Main agent should retest sketch edit-mode manually or with lower-level pointer events. No console errors were observed on the checklist or sketch draw screens. Deprecated warnings detected: 'shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents (many occurrences via react-native-web).

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-save via useFocusEffect cleanup fails on SDK 57. Sub-items added via addSubItem+confirmNewSubItem are lost when leaving the screen with system/router back (only Save&Back works).

integration_issues.flow: Checklist add sub-item → back navigate → reopen
integration_issues.issue: Storage aufmassprofi_checklists still has subItems: [] after nav-back; explicit Save button works. useFocusEffect cleanup executes but async ChecklistService.update never persists (fire-and-forget after unmount; state closure race).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Many screens trigger this.
Deprecated warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.

action_items: FIX BUG 2 (HIGH): In /app/frontend/app/checklists/[id].tsx, replace the useFocusEffect autosave (lines 162-171) with a mechanism that reliably persists on unmount. Options: (a) debounced save on every setChecklist/setHasChanges change via useEffect on checklist; (b) keep a ref (checklistRef, hasChangesRef) synced via useEffect and read the ref in cleanup and await the save; (c) use navigation beforeRemove listener (from @react-navigation/native) which supports async cleanup. Verify with pattern: add sub-item → hardware/SPA back → reopen → sub-item MUST persist.

Retest sketch tools manually (Pen freehand drag, Line via 'Linientyp wählen' modal, Circle, Rectangle, Angle, Text, Measure Line/Polygon, Edit-select/move/delete, Undo/Redo, Zoom, Grid, Delete Page) — Playwright mouse events on RN PanResponder on web preview did not yield reliable coverage. Note: on web the default tool is 'Zoom' — verify this is intentional after SDK 57 upgrade.
Address react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) globally — likely one shared style-util migration.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/checklists/[id].tsx:162-171 — useFocusEffect cleanup calls async saveChecklistSilent() as fire-and-forget. On SDK 57/expo-router 5.x + React 19 this pattern is unreliable because the async work may be scheduled after unmount and never awaited. Use a ref-based sync + navigation beforeRemove or a debounced useEffect.

/app/frontend/services/LocalStorage.ts:1465-1495 — ChecklistService.create/update rely on chkExtractImages which mutates via spread; subItems structure is preserved correctly — not the cause of the bug.
File /app/frontend/app/checklists/[id].tsx is >1700 lines — should be split into subcomponents (RecursiveItem, MeasurementModal, Numpad) for maintainability.

rca_of_issue:
BUG 2 RCA — checklist sub-item lost after back navigation:
1) User taps 'Add sub-item' → openInputs adds the path, TextInput appears (autoFocus).
2) User types text + Enter → confirmNewSubItem() calls setChecklist(newItems) and setHasChanges(true). Sub-item is visible in UI, banner 'Unsaved changes' appears.
3) User taps back (SPA router.back or full nav): useFocusEffect cleanup runs — `if (hasChanges && checklist) saveChecklistSilent()` — but saveChecklistSilent is invoked without await; component tree unmounts; the AsyncStorage.setItem inside ChecklistService.update is scheduled after unmount and never completes (verified: aufmassprofi_checklists in localStorage remains with subItems:[]).
4) On reopen, loadChecklist reads the (unchanged) storage → sub-item missing.
Explicit 'Save & Back' works because handleSave awaits ChecklistService.update before router.back().
Reproduction on web:
  - seed cl1 with one checked item and empty subItems
  - open /checklists/cl1 → tap 'Add sub-item' → type X → Enter
  - page.go_back()
  - JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('aufmassprofi_checklists'))[0].items[0].subItems === [] ← BUG
Mitigation: replace useFocusEffect with either (a) debounced auto-save useEffect on [checklist, hasChanges] persisting on every change, or (b) navigation beforeRemove listener that awaits the save and only then allows the pop.
